title: The Twin Thunderhead Canon
summary: A canon of two great thunderheads raised in the qi field and brought together in a collision of paired weight.

title: Treatise of Paired Squall and River Rain
summary: A treatise on pairing a hard squall with a long river of rain so that one pins and the other drowns.

title: The Basin Tempest Mastery
summary: A mastery of filling the body with storm qi like a basin and loosing the whole tempest in one overflow.

title: The Hawk Lightning Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of lightning moves that watch from height and fall as talons on the one chosen.

title: Canon of the Azure Tempest
summary: A canon of the clear blue storm that gathers out of an empty sky and answers its summoner with a crown of weather.

title: The Plateau Storm Canon
summary: A canon of broad flat storms that sweep the open plateau and settle a fight by wide level weight.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Anchored Thunder
summary: A treatise on anchoring the body with an oath so that sworn thunder falls on the oath-breaker alone.

title: The Windward Storm Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of storm moves that face into the wind and turn its whole weight against the one who sent it.

title: Manual of the Bearing Squall
summary: A manual of taking a bearing through the squall and loosing a strike that follows it to the target without fail.

title: The Sworn Tempest Treatise
summary: A treatise on a tempest sworn to its caller and loosed over allies and foes alike at the caller's word.
